title: Law to create low-cost veterinary clinics in every borough
summary: This bill would require the Health Department to establish at least one low-cost veterinary clinic in each borough, offering services such as vaccinations, spay/neuter and microchipping. Households earning up to 120% of area median income would pay reduced fees on a sliding scale, while those at or below 30% of AMI or on public assistance would receive free services. The department would have one year to open the clinics and must report annually on their use and operation.
